summary: Mid-market CCaaS vendor building a live agent-assist layer for 24/7 support. Focus: streaming suggestions with ultra-low latency, tool-calling into their ticketing/CRM, and robust behavior guardrails for compliance.
timeline: 2026-01-12: Intro demo with AE (Daniel) + SE (Priya). Client liked streaming suggestions UI.
2026-01-28: Security kickoff; Elmbridge sent initial SOC2 questionnaire (drive link).
2026-02-14: POC scope defined — 30 agents, 2 contact centers, 1 week baseline + spike test.
2026-03-01: POC day 5 log review; observed increased tail latency during scheduled batch jobs.

2026-03-05: Redwood perf lab scheduled for 2026-03-15 to validate 5k concurrent suggestion throughput.
technical_requirements: End-to-end suggestion latency <= 200ms p95 (preferred p90 < 120ms) for agent UI streaming
Support continuous streaming (partial hypothesis suggestions) + ability to cancel/replace in-flight tokens
Fallback policy: degrade to text-only suggestions or lower-capacity model when microburst > 8k concurrent
Tool-calling: sign-and-call patterns for ticket create/update, with idempotency and auditable traces
Guardrails: response redaction rules, allow-listing of external APIs, and audit logging of tool invocations
Caching: prefix/KV cache for common scripts and context to cut token cost on repeat flows
Throughput target: sustain 5k concurrent agent suggestion streams with median token rate 15 tps per agent during peak
Model preferences: small-medium LLM for suggestions (open-model variants), option to fallback to larger models for complex summarization
Routing: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for EU accounts) and reserved capacity for spikes
poc_details: Phase 1 (2 weeks): integrate Redwood hosted endpoint, streaming UI, evaluate latency and correctness on 30 agents
Phase 2 (2 weeks): run simulated microbursts (1k -> 8k concurrent) using Redwood lab; test fallback and canary rollout
Metrics: p50/p90/p95 latency, token cost per suggestion, false positive guardrail incidents, number of tool-call failures
Success criteria: p95 latency <= 200ms at 5k concurrent OR graceful fallback w/ <2% error propagation, audit logs available for all tool calls
Deliverables: security pack (SOC2 snippets), performance report, recommended batching/caching config
